objective: Measure the natural two-summand relation probability for the target-independent degree-23 algebraic divisor factor base, with planted-SAT and exact proven-UNSAT controls, before budgeting a larger scalar-hidden index-calculus run.

factor_base.selection_rule: cofactor admissible; maximize rational points; minimize projected signed-Frobenius columns; lower curve-a variant; lexicographically lower divisor indices

natural.construction: domain-separated BLAKE3 x-coordinate draws, deterministic lift selection, and cofactor projection; reject infinity and duplicates

planted_sat.construction: domain-separated deterministic priorities over canonical factor-base pairs whose sum is a non-infinity subgroup point; reject cross-arm duplicates. The sampling unit is a pair, so targets with multiple decompositions receive multiple priority opportunities and the planted target distribution is multiplicity-weighted

proven_unsat.construction: domain-separated hash-to-curve/cofactor candidates accepted only when absent from the complete canonical pair table; reject infinity and cross-arm duplicates

exact_reference_oracle.method: enumerate every canonical factor-base pair i <= j exactly once and key its exact curve sum
exact_reference_oracle.complete_for: two-summand decomposition over the fully materialized frozen factor base with repetition
exact_reference_oracle.point_equality: exact affine field elements with a distinct infinity key

statistics.primary_estimand: natural exact two-summand hit probability under the frozen hash-to-subgroup target distribution
statistics.sampling_assumption: The Wilson interval treats the frozen domain-separated BLAKE3 natural stream as a pseudorandom Bernoulli sample from the stated hash-to-subgroup distribution
statistics.without_replacement: Accepted natural targets are distinct, so sampling is without replacement
statistics.finite_population_correction: Not applied. At production size, 256 distinct nonidentity targets are about 0.000122 of the 2,095,852-point nonidentity subgroup population, so the correction is negligible at the reported precision
statistics.planted_multiplicity_boundary: Planted controls are selected by pair priority and are multiplicity-weighted by decomposition count; their 64/64 hit rate is a correctness control, not a prevalence estimate
statistics.trials_per_relation: natural_count / natural_hits; infinity when natural_hits is zero
statistics.controls: planted_sat must be 64/64 hits and proven_unsat must be 64/64 misses

execution.task_order: one fresh-target locked offline build; two public discovery processes in curve-a order; one relation-yield producer

accounting.single_core_claim: unavailable; the legacy process-meter field is aggregate CPU, not measured single-core elapsed time
accounting.peak_rss_scope: maximum high-water RSS reported for each fresh process. Scientific producers are sequential and request one worker; the Cargo build may overlap its parent with a compiler child, so simultaneous aggregate build-tree RSS remains unavailable

forbidden_inference: the balanced Phase-B panel estimates natural relation prevalence
a planted hit rate estimates natural relation prevalence
the planted pair-priority target distribution is uniform over distinct decomposable targets
one n=23 yield estimate is a scaling law
pair-table performance is a Semaev-SAT performance result
this experiment is a complete index-calculus run
this experiment establishes a rho crossover, novelty, external reproduction, or SOTA
claim_boundary: A complete run measures one public synthetic n=23 two-summand relation-yield distribution and validates its exact controls. It does not recover a scalar, compare full index calculus with rho, establish asymptotic scaling, or satisfy independent external review.
